title: Local feedback evaluation contract parity
description: Harden local GraphQL routing and resolver behavior for feedback-evaluation flows: feedback item index roots, evaluation roots, score-result-by-evaluation roots, and relationship selections used by FeedbackItems and evaluate feedback.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented local contract-parity hardening for feedback flows: legacy feedback composite index alias classification, alias routing tests, list pagination nextToken support in local mode, and composite between-filter handling (including timestamp range semantics). Verified with proxy tests and local feedback smoke using max-items=200.
